steps.action: Log in to the official AICTE portal (aicte-india.org) to verify the PRAGATI and Swanath scholarship details, create an account, and start the application.
Request an income certificate from the local Tahsildar/Nadakacheri office (processing can take 1–2 weeks) and obtain the current year’s fee receipt from your college.
Submit the completed AICTE PRAGATI and Swanath applications on the official portal before the 31 Oct deadline.
Visit the Minorities Welfare Department’s official portal to confirm the Post‑Matric Scholarship eligibility and apply before the 30 Nov deadline.

If you wish to pursue the PM YASASVI Top Class scholarship, confirm the ‘Open to: OBC, EBC, DNT’ rule on the official Social Justice and Empowerment portal or with your college scholarship cell, and apply only if you qualify.

plan.summary: Focus first on the two AICTE scholarships because they are confirmed eligible, offer ₹50,000 per year, and close in two days. Then apply for the Minorities Welfare Department’s Post‑Matric Scholarship, which is also confirmed eligible and has a later deadline.
